title: Hancock–Dibble debate and the shipwreck data

tellings.quote: you can see Graham Hancock debate flint dible and then you can fact checked Flint Dibble and realized that he got all his shipwreck data completely wrong

plain: In a 2024 debate between the writer Graham Hancock, who argues for a lost ancient civilization, and the archaeologist Flint Dibble, Dibble is said to have got all his shipwreck data completely wrong. Michels says this himself, telling listeners they can watch the debate and then fact-check Dibble. If true, it would weaken one of the arguments made against Hancock's ideas.
